{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the three channels
channels = df['channel'].unique()
print(f'Unique channels: {channels}')

# Check if there are exactly three
print(f'Number of unique channels: {len(channels)}')

# Check if any channel is missing
expected_channels = {'email', 'paid_search'}
missing_channels = expected_channels - set(channels)
print(f'Missing channels: {missing_channels}')"}
